approvers: Tax adviser, house bank of the buyer, family, notary
reason: A Belize shell with no track record and no committed funding is not who I hand my life's work to. My staff and my name matter more to me than a few euros more, and I would not even open my numbers to them.
objection: I do not know a Belize holding company; who stands behind it and where do I take a claim if it goes wrong? They have no money committed, and 30% deferred over three years is paid by a company I cannot check.
instead: Keep looking for a successor in the family or among staff, or list the business anonymously on nexxt-change and talk to a German buyer my adviser and bank already know.
would_change_my_mind: A named German or EU owner with proof of funds already at a bank, a bank guarantee or escrow for the deferred 30%, and references from owners they have already bought from.
